scope: Immutable byte-copy publication of completed fixed 28 jobs; not a new benchmark or claim of performance improvement.
copyPolicy: Exact original bytes; no JSON reserialization, newline conversion, verdict rewrite, path rewrite, or image decode.
inventorySelfHashPolicy: inventory.json is hashed by SHA256SUMS; SHA256SUMS is hashed by the external curation result.
limits: 28 collection PASS does not mean 28 performance improvements.
140 sync completion-ms rows are not FPS.
Low/mobile reverse repeats and full image-quality review are not included.
No runtime0–7 summary publication in this folder.
